## Image.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `src` :: Image source URL.
- `alt` :: Alternative text description for assistive technologies.
- `aspectRatio` :: Aspect ratio frame using Fractalstyler frame classes.
- `fit` :: How the bitmap scales inside the frame.
- `shape` :: Corner shape of the image frame.
- `caption` :: Optional caption displayed underneath in `<figcaption>`.
- `fallback` :: Custom fallback snippet shown when the image fails or `src` is empty.
- `surface` :: The surface behind the image: fill, border and shadow in one choice.
- `gap` :: The space between the frame and the caption under it. @default 'gap-xs'
- `textSize` :: The scale of the text in the built-in fallback.
- `textColor` :: The ink of that fallback text.
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the caption under the frame.
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the caption.
